evidence_quotes.O: I've taken this on 15 international flights (Europe, US, Australia) and all over location shooting, surf, sand, forests, deserts, just fine.
evidence_quotes.C: I checked the forums (dpreview and Steve's Camera) and found out that quite a few people are having the same problem.
evidence_quotes.E: I've been using these for internet connection (teaching classes online) and have no problem with the headphones.
evidence_quotes.A: These tripods are perfect for advanced hobbyists or professionals who want a good quality, lightweight, durable tripod but with an affordable price tag.
evidence_quotes.N: I've caught the skin of my finger in it twice now, causing me to bleed at the airport TSA line, which is problematic.
